supporting_observations.claim: The user reports a PowerShell window appearing around 13:40 UTC; however, no PowerShell process execution is recorded on WS-MLOPEZ-01 during the requested window (13:20 - 14:20 UTC).
The workstation performed standard Windows Update activity at 13:44 UTC, connecting to download.windowsupdate.com.
Activity on the workstation consists of routine system processes (SearchProtocolHost, WmiPrvSE, conhost), web browsing to StackOverflow, and Office 365 usage.

known_telemetry_limitations: Lack of process command-line logging for some events may hide the exact nature of some executions, though no PowerShell processes were seen in the provided logs.
claims_not_established: The exact cause of the reported brief PowerShell window cannot be established because no PowerShell process was captured in the logs.
unrelated_findings: Unapproved software Google Drive File Stream was executed on WS-MLOPEZ-01 at 14:11 UTC (T024-00278, T024-00280).
